data.name: CD3_001
data.value: Not good,[pause=10] not good,[pause=10] not good...

data.name: CD3_002
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] what am I going to do?[pause=0] I should never have stolen it...

data.name: CD3_003
data.value: A-are you {0}?

data.name: CD3_004
data.value: Um...[pause=0] Y-yes?[pause=0] W-who are you?

data.name: CD3_005
data.value: We're T-Team {0}![pause=0] We're an adventuring team!

data.name: CD3_006
data.value: We're from the A-Adventurer's Guild and we're here to p-place you under arrest!

data.name: CD3_007
data.value: A-a-a-adventurers!?

data.name: CD3_008
data.value: H-hey,[pause=10] you don't have to be scared![pause=0] We won't hurt you!

data.name: CD3_009
data.value: Sniff...[pause=0] R-r-really?

data.name: CD3_010
data.value: Yup.[pause=0] But you're going to have to come with us.

data.name: CD3_011
data.value: We've got this wanted poster here with your name on it,[pause=10] so we need to bring you in.

data.name: CD3_012
data.value: O-oh.[pause=0] Well...[pause=0] OK.[pause=0] I guess I can't run away forever...

data.name: CD3_013
data.value: Hmm...[pause=0] You don't seem like a bad Pokémon to me...[pause=0] How'd you end up with a bounty,[pause=10] anyway?

data.name: CD3_014
data.value: U-um,[pause=10] well,[pause=10] ever since I was young I've idolized those who are beautiful and majestic.

data.name: CD3_015
data.value: I've always wanted to be just like them...[pause=0] But it's hard to pull that off as a {0}.

data.name: CD3_016
data.value: So I've tried to find anything I could in my travels that would help me become beautiful.

data.name: CD3_017
data.value: One day I came across a shopkeeper who was selling the most gorgeous scarf I had ever seen.

data.name: CD3_018
data.value: I thought that maybe with a scarf like that,[pause=10] I could finally look how I've always wanted to!

data.name: CD3_019
data.value: So,[pause=10] I asked him how much it was.

data.name: CD3_020
data.value: The price he told me was staggering...[pause=0] I didn't have that kind of money!

data.name: CD3_021
data.value: It was just so beautiful though...[pause=0] I had to have it![pause=0]\nI couldn't help but steal it.

data.name: CD3_022
data.value: I felt so bad for taking it afterwards...[pause=0] I knew what I did was wrong.

data.name: CD3_023
data.value: But it was too late.[pause=0] I had stolen something,[pause=10] and became a wanted Pokémon.

data.name: CD3_024
data.value: I ran away,[pause=10] and hid here hoping the bandits would deter others from looking for me.

data.name: CD3_025
data.value: Seems like that didn't work though,[pause=10] huh?

data.name: CD3_026
data.value: Why didn't you just give it back?[pause=0] Maybe the shopkeeper would have forgiven you?

data.name: CD3_028
data.value: Um...[pause=0] Because,[pause=10] deep down,[pause=10] I still want to keep the scarf.

data.name: CD3_029
data.value: It's just so beautiful![pause=0] And it still makes me feel so beautiful too...

data.name: CD3_030
data.value: So I haven't tried to give it back yet.

data.name: CD3_031
data.value: But I think it's time that I face the music.

data.name: CD3_032
data.value: I'll give back what I stole and take my punishment.[pause=0] It's only fair...

data.name: CD3_033
data.value: What you did was wrong,[pause=10] but I understand why you did it at least.

data.name: CD3_034
data.value: I feel bad about having to arrest you now.[pause=0] Still,[pause=10] it's our job...

data.name: CD3_035
data.value: Well,[pause=10] I'm glad we were able to resolve this without a fight.[pause=0] I hope the law doesn't go hard on you.

data.name: CD3_036
data.value: Team [color=#FFA5FF]Style[color]!?

data.name: CD3_037
data.value: Move these losers out of the way!

data.name: CD3_038
data.value: Right away,[pause=10] boss!

data.name: CD3_039
data.value: So you're the outlaw this sorry excuse of an adventuring team was after...

data.name: CD3_040
data.value: Well,[pause=10] you're ours now!

data.name: CD3_041
data.value: Eeep!

data.name: CD3_042
data.value: Team [color=#FFA5FF]Style[color]![pause=0] What are you doing here!?

data.name: CD3_043
data.value: Wh-what!?[pause=0] What do you mean!?

data.name: CD3_044
data.value: When we spoke with you chumps earlier,[pause=10] you mentioned you were headed off on your first outlaw job.

data.name: CD3_045
data.value: That's when it occurred to me...

data.name: CD3_046
data.value: How would it look if another team brought home that outlaw instead of you?

data.name: CD3_047
data.value: Y-you don't m-mean...

data.name: CD3_048
data.value: That's right,[pause=10] darlings.[pause=0] Once {0} came up with the idea,[pause=10] he told us the plan.

data.name: CD3_049
data.value: We started to act like we had suddenly developed respect for you,[pause=10] then off we went.

data.name: CD3_050
data.value: But really,[pause=10] we just started trailing you.[pause=0] You had no idea you were being followed,[pause=10] did you?

data.name: CD3_051
data.value: I can't believe you losers fell for it.[pause=0] Like we could ever have any respect for wimps like you.

data.name: CD3_052
data.value: Especially with how many times you failed to even make it to the end of this place!

data.name: CD3_053
data.value: And now,[pause=10] we'll be claiming the bounty on this outlaw's head.[pause=0] Not you.

data.name: CD3_054
data.value: I wonder how that's gonna reflect on you when you get back to your precious guild.

data.name: CD3_055
data.value: I can't believe you jerks![pause=0] Don't you have anything better to do?

data.name: CD3_056
data.value: Don't you have anything better to do than to play pretend!?

data.name: CD3_057
data.value: Don't you get that you chumps are making us real adventuring teams look bad?

data.name: CD3_058
data.value: Team [color=#FFA5FF]Style[color] can't become the glamorous team it's destined to be with jokers like you running around!

data.name: CD3_059
data.value: Playing pretend!?[pause=0] Are you kidding me!?

data.name: CD3_060
data.value: We're the real adventuring team![pause=0] You're the fakers who couldn't get into the guild!

data.name: CD3_061
data.value: That is IT![pause=0] You wanna do this the hard way,[pause=10] that works for us!

data.name: CD3_064
data.value: New plan![pause=0] We're no longer interested in bagging this outlaw!

data.name: CD3_065
data.value: We're just gonna trounce these posers to stop THEM from doing it!

data.name: CD3_066
data.value: Um,[pause=10] don't I get a say in this?

data.name: CD3_067
data.value: Now then...

data.name: CD3_068
data.value: You're really in for it now,[pause=10] darlings.

data.name: CD3_069
data.value: The boss says you have to go!

data.name: CD3_070
data.value: Get ready for your beatdown,[pause=10] you no-talent chumps!

data.name: CD3_071
data.value: Get ready,[pause=10] {0}![pause=0] Here they come!

data.name: CD3_072
data.value: Duh...[pause=0] Boss?[pause=0] Where did they go?

data.name: CD3_073
data.value: They must have retreated.[pause=0] Those cowards...

data.name: CD3_074
data.value: We really showed them who's boss,[pause=10] didn't we?

data.name: CD3_075
data.value: Huhuh,[pause=10] yeah,[pause=10] we sure did,[pause=10] huhuh!

data.name: CD3_076
data.value: But,[pause=10] duh...[pause=0] What do we do now,[pause=10] boss?

data.name: CD3_077
data.value: Those losers are gonna have to come back if they want to complete their mission.

data.name: CD3_078
data.value: We're gonna wait here until they come back and embarrass them again with another beatdown!

data.name: CD3_079
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] that's absolutely devilish,[pause=10] {0}![pause=0] I love that plan!

data.name: CD3_080
data.value: Huhuh,[pause=10] yup![pause=0] That's a great idea![pause=0] That's why you're the boss!

data.name: CD3_081
data.value: Eeep!

data.name: CD3_082
data.value: Th-that...[pause=0] was cheap...

data.name: CD3_083
data.value: Th-this...[pause=0] isn't o-over...

data.name: CD3_084
data.value: Y-you haven't s-seen the last of...[pause=0] T-Team [color=#FFA5FF]Style[color]...[pause=0] Losers...

data.name: CD3_085
data.value: We did it![pause=0] We put those bullies in their place,[pause=10] {0}!

data.name: CD3_086
data.value: {0},[pause=10] are you okay?[pause=0] Did those jerks hurt you at all?

data.name: CD3_087
data.value: I'm fine,[pause=10] but...

data.name: CD3_088
data.value: You're wondering how I'm doing?[pause=0] Aren't I an outlaw here?

data.name: CD3_089
data.value: Just because you're an outlaw doesn't mean I want to see you hurt!

data.name: CD3_090
data.value: Besides,[pause=10] you're nicer than most of the Pokémon we've had to deal with recently.

data.name: CD3_091
data.value: Sniff...[pause=0] I can't believe how nice you're being towards a criminal like me.

data.name: CD3_092
data.value: That means a lot to me...[pause=0] Thank you...

data.name: CD3_093
data.value: Of course![pause=0] I'm just glad to hear you're unharmed!

data.name: CD3_094
data.value: But...[pause=0] We still do need to bring you in now.[pause=0] I'm sorry...

data.name: CD3_095
data.value: It's OK.[pause=0] I understand...

data.name: CD3_096
data.value: Alright,[pause=10] {0}.[pause=0] Let's get a move on back to the guild.

data.name: CD3_097
data.value: Wow,[pause=10] boss![pause=0] They really did come back,[pause=10] just like you said they would!

data.name: CD3_098
data.value: Of course I was right,[pause=10] you idiot![pause=0] When am I ever wrong?

data.name: CD3_099
data.value: If they came back,[pause=10] they must really enjoy being humiliated.[pause=0] What a bunch of weirdos!

data.name: CD3_100
data.value: We're here for {0}![pause=0] We still have our mission to complete!

data.name: CD3_101
data.value: That's strange,[pause=10] darlings,[pause=10] because the only thing you're going to find here...

data.name: CD3_102
data.value: ...Is another beatdown![pause=0] Delivered by yours truly!

data.name: CD3_103
data.value: Get ready![pause=0] We're going to remind you why you're not fit to be adventurers!

data.name: CD3_104
data.value: Waaaaaaaaah!!![pause=0] P-p-please don't h-hurt me!

data.name: CD3_105
data.value: I'm s-s-sorry for stealing it![pause=0] I'll go p-p-peacefully![pause=0] I s-swear!

data.name: CD3_106
data.value: Isn't it obvious?[pause=0] We're here to humiliate you!

data.name: CD3_107
data.value: And as for you...[pause=0] You'll be staying put here too![pause=0] Don't even think of running away!

data.name: CD3_108
data.value: Team [color=#FFA5FF]Style[color]!
